# Siemens X55 T9 Base Creator

**Author:** F.U.H.<br/>
**Platforms:** x35/x45/x55 (EGOLD)

<img
  className="screenshot"
  src={require("./t9-base-creator/img/t9-base-creator.png").default}
  alt={"Siemens X55 T9 Base Creator: screenshot 1"}
/>

This program is intended for creating a T9 database from available languages. You
can include only the required dictionaries in the database and get a ready BIN for
writing to the phone via V_KLay. The result file name contains the offset
corresponding to the selected model.

The package includes 22 language databases from the A55. The author tested the program on the Siemens
S55; the address of the T9 area for other models must be determined in advance,
for example using Smelter.
